commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
git fetch --no-tags origin feat/outgoing-live-qa-20261125
test "$(git rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/feat/outgoing-live-qa-20261125)" = "4e70f6a8860c87163164b426e27e62a7eac62709"
ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
WORK="$(mktemp -d /tmp/aicalls-lab-install-XXXXXX)"
trap 'cd "$ROOT"; git worktree remove --force "$WORK" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
git worktree add --detach "$WORK" "4e70f6a8860c87163164b426e27e62a7eac62709"
cd "$WORK"
echo "QA_SHA=4e70f6a8860c87163164b426e27e62a7eac62709"
echo STAGE=BUILD_APK_ONLY
# Host QA already passed this exact source SHA. No repeated unit tests.
bash scripts/bin/test-profile.sh device-build
PKG=pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.s8lab
PROD=pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge
APP=app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
test -s "$APP"
SERIAL="$(PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -m aicall_tools.device.s22_adb_discovery --serial RFCT70L7E8J)"
phone_idle() {
  local state mode
  state="$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9]\).*/\1/p' | head -n1 | tr -d '\r')"
  mode="$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys audio | sed -n 's/.*Actual mode = \(MODE_[A-Z_]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1 | tr -d '\r')"
  [[ "$state" == 0 && "$mode" == MODE_NORMAL ]]
}
role() {
  adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd role get-role-holders --user 0 android.app.role.DIALER | tr -d '\r'
}
phone_idle || { echo PHONE_NOT_IDLE=true; exit 50; }
test "$(role)" = "$PROD" || { echo DIALER_ROLE_CHANGED=true; exit 51; }
test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.build.version.release | tr -d '\r')" = 16
prod_before="$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path "$PROD" | tr -d '\r')"
[[ "$prod_before" == package:* ]] || exit 52
if [[ "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path "$PKG" 2>/dev/null || true)" == package:* ]]; then
  echo LAB_ALREADY_INSTALLED_NO_OVERWRITE=true; exit 53
fi
echo STAGE=INSTALL_ISOLATED_LAB
phone_idle || exit 54
adb -s "$SERIAL" install --no-streaming "$APP"
paths="$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path "$PKG" | tr -d '\r')"
[[ "$(printf '%s\n' "$paths" | grep -c '^package:')" == 1 ]] || exit 55
remote="$(printf '%s\n' "$paths" | sed -n 's/^package://p')"
adb -s "$SERIAL" pull "$remote" "$WORK/installed-lab.apk" >/dev/null
test "$(shasum -a 256 "$APP" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$(shasum -a 256 "$WORK/installed-lab.apk" | awk '{print $1}')"
echo LAB_APK_SHA256_MATCH=true
adb -s "$SERIAL" shell run-as "$PKG" id >/dev/null
echo PRIVATE_ADB_ACCESS=true
test "$(role)" = "$PROD"
test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path "$PROD" | tr -d '\r')" = "$prod_before"
phone_idle
echo LAB_INSTALLED=true
echo PRODUCTION_ROLE_UNCHANGED=true
echo NO_CALLS_NO_HOST_SWITCH=true
echo "QA_SHA=4e70f6a8860c87163164b426e27e62a7eac62709"
